invariants.rationale: As per the Javadoc, result is -1 if no such layer exists, else a non-negative index.
If get(name) returns null, there is no such layer and result should be -1, otherwise, result is a valid index.
If the input name is null, it likely matches no layer, so result should be -1.
If result is not -1, get(name) must have returned a layer.
